description: This is the main entry point for a Vue.js single-page application. It imports global CSS, initializes the Vue app, sets up state management via Pinia, configures routing, and mounts the app to the DOM.

methods.name: app.use(createPinia())
methods.description: Registers Pinia state management plugin with the Vue application.

methods.name: app.use(router)
methods.description: Registers the router for navigation within the Vue application.

methods.name: app.mount('#app')
methods.description: Mounts the Vue application to the DOM element with ID 'app'.
